items.title: File Davidson County business personal property return
items.authority: Davidson County County Assessor of Property
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File the Metro Nashville and Davidson County hotel/motel occupancy tax return
items.authority: Metro Nashville Collections Office (Department of Finance)
items.description: Monthly hotel occupancy returns, with the exemption report, are due to the Collections Office by the 20th of each month. The local rate is 7% from July 1, 2023, plus a $2.50 nightly fee. Forms are downloaded, not mailed out. Short-term rentals pay through a separate page.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File Hamilton County business personal property return
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment.

items.title: File the Hamilton County hotel/motel occupancy tax return
items.description: Reports and payment are due at the Trustee's office by the 20th of the following month, and a return is required monthly even if no tax is due. County delinquency costs 12% interest a year plus 2% for each month or fraction late.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File Knox County business personal property return
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment.

items.title: File the Knox County hotel/motel occupancy tax return
items.description: The hotel/motel/campground occupancy tax return must be filed with the County Clerk by the 20th of the following month, even when no tax is due (form dated 2017; confirm it is current). Knoxville's city lodging tax is separate.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File Rutherford County business personal property return
items.authority: Rutherford County County Assessor of Property
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

note: Rutherford County has a hotel tax collected by the County Clerk under a private act, but its monthly due date was not found (the City of Murfreesboro's is the 20th).

items.title: File Shelby County business personal property return
items.authority: Shelby County County Assessor of Property
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File the Shelby County hotel/motel occupancy tax return
items.description: The County Clerk collects a 5% room occupancy privilege tax on hotel, motel and bed-and-breakfast stays (Private Acts of 1969, chapter 131). The page read does not give the return due date; call the Clerk at (901) 222-3059.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File Williamson County business personal property return
items.description: Tennessee tangible personal property schedules are mailed by February 1 and due to the county assessor by March 1; non-filers get a forced assessment.

note: Williamson County has a 4% hotel privilege tax remitted to the County Clerk under a private act, but its due date was not found (the City of Franklin's is the 20th).
